Container.Name: PlexInformationBot
Container.Overview: A Discord bot that shows what your Plex server is doing: viewers in the bot status, a live streams message, an optional Radarr/Sonarr download queue and a role message. Configure everything on the built-in setup page (first sign-in: admin / admin).

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port for the setup page. Change this to reach the page on a different port; the WebUI link follows it.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings and login are stored here.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the bot runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the bot runs as (100 = users).
